_description: Control descriptions for Lab 16, modelled on the SY0-701 1.1 category × type matrix. expected_* fields are the answer key used by the tests to measure classifier accuracy; the engine never reads them.

controls.description: Firewall rules block traffic from untrusted networks.
Door locks keep unauthorized people out of the server room.
A login splash screen warns that unauthorized use will be prosecuted.
Posted warning signs state that trespassers will be prosecuted.
The threat of demotion discourages employees from violating the security policy.
System logs record every login attempt for later review.
Motion detectors trigger an alarm when someone enters after hours.
Managers review login reports each week to find unusual access.
Security guards patrol the property at night to spot intruders.
Backups are used to recover data after it is corrupted.
A fire extinguisher is used to put out a fire in the data center.
After a break-in, staff follow the procedure to contact law enforcement and restore normal operations.
Endpoint protection quarantines malicious files and rolls the system back to a clean state.
A legacy server that cannot be patched is protected by a firewall rule that blocks the vulnerable port instead.
Because the team is too small for full separation of duties, a manager reviews every change instead.
A generator keeps the data center running when the primary power source is unavailable.
The compliance policy states that all staff must complete privacy training every year.
A sign on the door reads: Authorized personnel only.
We use a cloud platform for most workloads.
